claims.text: The rider was neither silent nor uncontactable, and the driver left the exchange hanging. The chat log records the driver's message 'hi im at the pickup point, where are you' at 19:59:12 (read by the rider at 19:59:52) and the rider's reply 'coming down now' at 20:01:07 - sent inside the waiting window that opened with the driver's arrival at 19:58:47 and closed at termination at 20:06:00. Under POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) that reply is a coordinating message, and the driver neither posted any reply within 120 seconds of it (his only message predates it) nor placed any in-app voice call before terminating the trip: trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. This is the coordination failure the clause is aimed at, and the rider did everything limbs (a) and (b) ask of him.

The rider does not press exoneration under POL-NS-04 and does not ask the Judge to treat limb (c) as satisfied, because the rider's own trace reports the rider's device between 884.0 m and 891.3 m from the pickup pin and motionless throughout (every rider fix at 0.0 km/h), and the code reports rider_qualifying_fix_count as 0 - so the 100 m STANDARD presence radius is not made out on the rider's own reported positions. The rider concedes that limb rather than stretch it. If the zero qualifying count reflects the 25 m accuracy filter rather than distance - no horizontal-accuracy value for any rider fix is exposed in the brief - limb (c) is undecidable under POL-NS-11 and the Judge should say the test could not be run rather than inferring the rider was elsewhere; that distinction is the only thing the rider asks the Judge to hold.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road in this window. EV-ADVIS-02701-01 is MISSING - a blocking MISSING_ARTIFACT issue, admissibility weight 0.0 - and its absence is itself citable. Under POL-NS-06 limb (i) a traffic_advisory must be present and populated before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed, so the driver cannot extend the measured dwell by accumulation; any dwell finding must rest on the single continuous run the trace actually contains, and nothing may be added to it from an absent artifact.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 19:58:47 on this trip, and the GPS trace independently corroborates it: the arrival derivation places the driver a minimum of 0.16 m from the pickup pin and reports 44 qualifying in-geofence fixes for a START/STANDARD zone whose arrival radius is 50 m. POL-NS-01(a) is satisfied and the POL-NS-02 proximity test (at least 3 consecutive in-radius fixes at 25 m accuracy or better) is met on the code-computed figures, not on any geometry of my own.

The driver held position inside the pickup geofence for one continuous qualifying run of 429 seconds, from 19:58:47 to 20:05:56, with a dwell start offset of 0.0 seconds from the first qualifying in-geofence fix. That is 249 seconds longer than the 180-second free waiting period carried in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec for this trip, and it exceeds even the 300-second minimum_dwell_sec figure retained in the fee schedule for STANDARD zones. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies. POL-NS-01(c) is satisfied and the fee is chargeable on the baseline clause.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 20:06:00 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is 253 seconds after the required 180-second dwell elapsed at 20:01:47, and the record shows no boarding event and no started trip. POL-NS-01(d) is therefore met on its own terms: the reason code is one of the three that limb (d) recognises, and DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE - the one code that would defeat the limb - is nowhere on the record.

This is not a false-arrival case under POL-NS-05. At the 19:58:47 'arrived' timestamp the trace places the driver essentially on the pin (derived minimum distance 0.16 m) and stationary - the driver track's own distinct speed set includes 0.0 kph - so neither trigger fires: the driver was not more than 300 m from the pin, and was not travelling at 15 kph or above. The waiting clock therefore runs from the arrival marker and from the first qualifying in-geofence fix alike, and nothing is recomputed against the driver.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. Even allowing that the rider's 'coming down now' message at 20:01:07 was locating or coordinating and went unanswered by the driver for more than 120 seconds with no in-app call on the record, limb (c) is affirmatively FAILED on admissible fixes: the rider's own track sits between 884 m and 891 m from the pickup pin with a mean of 888 m, and 0 of the rider's 62 fixes qualify inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. The rider was nowhere near the pickup point during the waiting window, so POL-NS-04 does not apply and the dispute falls to be decided under POL-NS-01.

POL-NS-06 does not bite either: the effective in-geofence dwell of 429 seconds is longer than the 180-second minimum, and the derivation records the shortfall as -249 seconds, that is, no shortfall at all. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02701-01 is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight multiplier 0.0, and I disclose that impairment expressly. Its absence makes the accumulation limb POL-NS-06(i) unavailable, but the driver never needed accumulation: POL-NS-06(ii) provides that an advisory can only permit separate intervals to be summed and never reduces the required minimum, so the absence of any advisory is not an adverse fact against the driver on this record.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged. That clause governs a driver stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here the driver's stationary fixes lie INSIDE the 50 m STANDARD radius, so this is not a wrong-entrance or wrong-face-of-the-venue case and no fault allocation from the chat log arises. The clause that decides the fee is POL-NS-01, on a driver who arrived at the pin itself.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force, which the fare breakdown's own money derivation states as SGD 3.60, the residual 20 percent being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip and cannot trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the threshold of 4, so the conjunctive test never reaches its rate limb. I rely on that named field alone, as POL-GEN-01 requires, and expressly do not rely on driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags (a lifetime counter, which is 1) or on rating or cancellation rate, all of which are context only.

There is no evidence-integrity defect under POL-NS-08. Limb (d) is not engaged: the fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 equals the net figure produced by reading trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (SGD 4.50) under the fee schedule's resolution rule, so the ledger line reconciles. Limb (a) is not engaged: the 19:58:47 'arrived' event matches the first qualifying GPS fix of the same second, a skew of zero, far inside the 90-second limit. Every artifact I rest on is COMPLETE at weight multiplier 1.0, so the deciding facts on arrival and dwell are carried by two independent full-weight sources and the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap does not bite.

No POL-NS-09 trigger is present, so this case needs no human reviewer. The two admissible artifacts that carry arrival and dwell agree rather than contradict - the trip record's 19:58:47 arrival matches the trace's first in-geofence fix - so trigger (b) is not met; neither party has any trailing-90-day no-show dispute with the other (rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0), so trigger (c) is not met; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so trigger (d) is not met; and the sole-evidence limb (e) is not met because the deciding facts rest on full-weight artifacts. I do not substitute the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counters for the trailing-window fields, which POL-NS-09(d) forbids.

The rider's account that he was 'only a few minutes late' is contradicted by the two contemporaneous records. The driver wrote 'hi im at the pickup point, where are you' at 19:59:12, read by the rider at 19:59:52; the rider answered only 'coming down now' at 20:01:07; and the driver did not cancel until 20:06:00, four minutes fifty-three seconds after that message, by which time the rider's device still lay 884 m or more from the pickup pin. A rider descending from a block 884 m away is not a rider who appears within the free waiting period the fee was paid for.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: this ruling decides the $4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02701. The fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.60.

Arrival and waiting (POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02). All four limbs hold. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 19:58:47. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02701) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius: the arrival derivation reports a minimum distance of 0.16 m from the pin and 44 qualifying in-geofence fixes, meeting POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-fix test. (c) The driver held position in the geofence for one continuous run of 429 s, from 19:58:47 to 20:05:56; the free waiting period in force is 180 s (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), so the dwell exceeded it by 249 s, and no longer threshold applies (no_show_threshold_sec is null). (d) The driver terminated at 20:06:00 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 253 s after the required dwell elapsed at 20:01:47, with no boarding event.

The rider's exoneration routes fail. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) is not engaged: at the 19:58:47 marker the driver sat essentially on the pin (0.16 m) and stationary (0.0 kph), so neither the 300 m nor the 15 kph trigger fires. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) is not engaged: the stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m radius, not between the radius and the 400 m ceiling. POL-NS-06 (shortfall) is not engaged: 429 s exceeds the 180 s minimum and the derived shortfall is -249 s; the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02701-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, disclosed here), but its absence only makes the accumulation limb (i) unavailable — no accumulation was needed, and POL-NS-06(ii) never reduces the required minimum.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. The rider's 'coming down now' message at 20:01:07 was a coordinating message (limb (a)) and the driver neither replied within 120 s nor placed any in-app call (limb (b), in_app_calls empty); but limb (c) fails. The rider's own track places the device between 884 m and 891 m from the pin, and 0 of 62 rider fixes fall inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. On this record the zero qualifying count is explained by distance, not by the 25 m accuracy filter, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed rather than undecidable; and even on the rider's alternative reading, POL-NS-11 provides that an undecidable limb (c) still cannot exonerate the rider and the fee is decided on the driver's evidence.

No integrity defect under POL-NS-08: the arrived event matches the first qualifying fix to the second (skew 0), the trace has no gaps and 88 fixes, the chat log is complete (2 of 2 messages), and the fare breakdown's 4.50 cancellation-fee line equals the net figure produced from platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (4.50). The deciding facts are carried by the GPS trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown, all at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap does not bite; confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor.

POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80% of the fee in force: 80% of SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60, the figure the fare breakdown's own money derivation states, the residual 20% being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below 4, so the rate limb is never reached. Per POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60. No POL-NS-09 trigger is present (the artifacts agree, both counterparty-conflict counters are 0, the anti-farming check does not trip, and the deciding facts are not impaired), so the case is not escalated, and no clause produces a referral. Profile fields were used only where a clause names them (POL-GEN-01): rating, cancellation rate and the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter are context only and carried no weight. The rider's account that he was 'only a few minutes late' is not supported — he was still some 880 m from the pickup when the driver cancelled. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the 8.00 execution threshold, so the ruling executes automatically (POL-GEN-05).

ruling.explanation:
This ruling concerns the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02701. The fee stands, and the platform pays the driver SGD 3.60. To the rider: your account that you were only a few minutes late is not accepted on the record. To the driver: your no-show is established and your compensation is fixed.

The no-show is proved on all four limbs of POL-NS-01, each on full-weight evidence. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 19:58:47. (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that moment: the closest fix is 0.16 m from the pin and there are 44 qualifying in-geofence fixes, so the POL-NS-02 test of at least three consecutive in-radius fixes at 25 m accuracy or better is met. (c) The driver held position continuously for 429 seconds (19:58:47 to 20:05:56), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as the clause requires rather than from the arrival tap, which is 249 seconds longer than the 180-second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec. (d) The driver terminated the trip at 20:06:00 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, 253 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 20:01:47, with no boarding event and no started trip. The arrival marker was true - the driver was on the pin and stationary, so neither the 300 m nor the 15 km/h trigger of POL-NS-05 fires - and nothing is recomputed.

The rider's account is contradicted by his own device track, which places him between 884 m and 891 m from the pickup pin and motionless (0.0 km/h) throughout the waiting window, with 0 of 62 fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. POL-NS-04 therefore does not exonerate him: his 'coming down now' message at 20:01:07 went unanswered by the driver within 120 seconds and no in-app call was made, satisfying limbs (a) and (b), but limb (c) is affirmatively failed. This is not the undecidable case of POL-NS-11: the rider track is present (62 fixes with measured distances), and the failure is on distance (884 m), not on the 25 m accuracy filter, so the test could be run and it failed.

The other rider-side routes are checked. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) is not engaged, because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) is not engaged, because the 429-second dwell exceeds the 180-second minimum by 249 seconds. Traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02701-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), which makes the accumulation limb POL-NS-06(i) unavailable; accumulation was never needed, and an absent advisory neither reduces the required minimum nor counts against the driver.

On integrity there is no defect under POL-NS-08: the arrival event and the first in-geofence fix share the same second, the trace has 100% coverage with no gap, the chat log holds the two messages the trip record counts, and the SGD 4.50 fare line reconciles to the platform-policy figure. The deciding facts - arrival and dwell - are carried by EV-TRIP-02701 and EV-GPS-02701, both at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor, and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires.

On the money: with POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, the fee stands and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80% of the SGD 4.50 net fee in force, i.e. SGD 3.60 (the residual SGD 0.90 is retained as the platform service fee; the gross figure of SGD 6.61 is not used). The anti-farming check does not trip - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the threshold of 4 - so compensation is paid. The ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and, per POL-GEN-03, amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 as driver_compensation_sgd: it is the amount the ruling moves, not a refund, and the rider's charge stands. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it executes automatically on issue. No clause produces a referral. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
